title: GroundAnything: Reconciling Parallel Decoding with Precise Visual Grounding at Flash Speed
abstract: arXiv:2609.39600v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autoregressive (AR) grounding models serialize spatial predictions, introducing sequential latency and imposing a causal order on output tokens. We view grounding as visual evidence extraction: objects, locations, and spatial relations are jointly constrained by the image and query, yet their dependencies do not imply an intrinsic left-to-right generation order. This distinction makes bidirectional diffusion a natural fit, allowing spatial hypotheses to emerge in parallel and be jointly refined through iterative denoising. We introduce GroundAnything, a 4B-parameter grounding foundation model that reconciles fast parallel decoding with precise localization through blockwise denoising. Training combines grounding pretraining from public datasets and dedicated data engines, direct AR-to-diffusion conversion with joint AR and diffusion objectives, supervised fine-tuning, and GRPO-based reinforcement post-training. translated_title: GroundAnything：以闪速实现并行解码与精准视觉定位的统一
translated_abstract: 自回归（AR）视觉定位模型将空间预测序列化，引入了顺序延迟，并对输出 token 施加了因果顺序约束。我们将视觉定位视为视觉证据提取：物体、位置和空间关系由图像和查询共同约束，但它们之间的依赖关系并不意味着存在内在的从左到右的生成顺序。这一区别使得双向扩散成为天然合适的选择，允许空间假设并行涌现，并通过迭代去噪进行联合优化。我们提出了 GroundAnything，一个 40 亿参数的视觉定位基础模型，通过分块去噪实现了快速并行解码与精准定位的统一。其训练过程结合了基于公开数据集与专用数据引擎的定位预训练、采用 AR 与扩散联合目标的直接 AR 到扩散架构转换、监督微调以及基于 GRPO 的强化后训练。在 30 个视觉定位基准测试上……
tldr: GroundAnything 是一个 40 亿参数的视觉定位基础模型，它将视觉定位重新定义为可并行生成的双向扩散过程，通过分块去噪、AR 到扩散的架构转换训练及 GRPO 强化后训练，在实现闪速并行解码的同时保证了精准的视觉定位效果。
en_tdlr: GroundAnything is a 4B-parameter grounding foundation model that recasts visual grounding as a parallel bidirectional diffusion process, using blockwise denoising, direct AR-to-diffusion conversion, and GRPO-based post-training to achieve flash-speed parallel decoding without sacrificing precise localization.
